tests.name: Exercise 2/4 - Authenticity guardrail: object model and validation structure
command: import ast, pathlib, sys; s = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding='utf-8'); t = ast.parse(s); classes = {n.name for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef)}; funcs = {n.name for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}; prop = sum(1 for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and any(isinstance(d, ast.Name) and d.id == 'property' for d in n.decorator_list)); setter = sum(1 for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and any(isinstance(d, ast.Attribute) and d.attr == 'setter' for d in n.decorator_list)); print('guardrail_model_classes_ok=' + str({'Task', 'TaskRepository', 'TaskService'}.issubset(classes))); print('guardrail_properties_ok=' + str(prop >= 1 and setter >= 1)); print('guardrail_domain_methods_ok=' + str({'create_task', 'summary'}.issubset(funcs))); print('guardrail_exceptions_ok=' + str(all(token in s for token in ('ValidationError', 'NotFoundError'))))
